description: Update an existing topic’s title, keyword, item, angle, pillar or note without removing its linked drafts. Only the fields you send change; an empty string or null clears an optional field. A keyword already covered by another topic is refused.

angle.description: Updated angle, up to 60 characters. Empty text or null clears it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A topic id from topics_list or topics_add.

item.description: Updated product or service, up to 120 characters. Empty text or null clears it.

keyword.description: Updated search phrase, up to 120 characters. Empty text or null clears it. One already covered by another topic is refused.

note.description: Updated note to remember when writing it, up to 400 characters. Empty text or null clears it.

pillar.description: Updated brand pillar, up to 120 characters. Empty text or null clears it.

title.description: Updated topic title, up to 160 characters.

name: topics_update
title: Update a topic
